candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Italian grammatical words, pronouns, and auxiliary verbs used to construct general sentences.
This feature vector activates on prominent historical figures, philosophers, and intellectuals, particularly of German-European origin and the 19th/20th centuries.
This vector activates on Latin root prefixes and suffixes associated with multilingual etymological stems, particularly in Romance languages.
This vector represents demonstrative determiners, pronouns, and quantifiers across Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the substring "us" or closely related morphological variants.
This vector activates on biomedical and anatomical root words, medical terminology, and cellular biology prefixes.
This vector represents Italian lexical roots and grammatical morphemes.
This vector represents suffixes, roots, and words containing the Latin-derived "-ment" morpheme across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the linguistic suffix "-is" or words ending with the Latin-derived suffix sound "-is".
This vector activates on words, name components, and subwords starting with the letters "Fr", "Fl", "Cre", or "Bre".
